## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Broad sector strength (Energy XLE (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, Industrials XLI (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.86%) ABOVE TREND) but risk ratios flat — VXX (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.46%) CORRECTION and SPY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY, HYG (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.05%) CORRECTION — mixed confirmations support a Neutral call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Energy rally led by BNO (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%) ABOVE TREND is the dominant driver; credit is neutral with HYG (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.05%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +0.59%) CORRECTION, while VXX (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.46%) CORRECTION shows localized volatility but no broad fear signal.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-supportive. TLT (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +3.00%) ABOVE TREND indicates demand for duration, dollar showing NEUTRAL (UUP (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL), and credit spreads broadly flat — conditions steady, not directional.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND; Cyclicals/Industrials showing strength: XLI (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.86%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging in RECOVERY: XLK (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY — style: cyclical/energy over growth for now.

5. US vs Global?  
US mixed: SPY (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY while small caps IWM (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND. EM mixed: EEM (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +1.75%) CORRECTION and China weakness clear with FXI (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation present but uneven: IBIT (1W: +7.24% | 1M: -17.66%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: +6.03% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY show strong 1W flows but weak 1M context; IWM ABOVE TREND signals continued risk tolerance in small caps.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Commodity-led reflation: BNO (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND driving headlines; copper CPER (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -5.99%) RECOVERY suggests selective industrial demand.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy dominant and broad: XLE (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +2.21% | 1M: -20.32%) RECOVERY is volatile but weaker on the month.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Sector breadth (8/11) and Energy/Industrial ETFs ABOVE TREND provide confirmation of cyclical leadership. Major divergence flagged: SPY, XLK and XLF show 1W vs 1M mismatches (SPY RECOVERY, XLK RECOVERY, XLF (1W: +0.31% | 1M: -4.58%) RECOVERY) — classified as MAJOR DIVERGENCE, so strong regime bets are suppressed.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals and energy exposure (XLE (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.86%) ABOVE TREND) and small-cap participation (IWM (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to China/EM beta (FXI (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND) and monitor tech momentum (XLK (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND for continuation on oil strength.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY for a potential rollover if 1M weakness persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +10.18% | 1M: +13.88%) ABOVE TREND for price spillovers to cyclicals.  
BEARISH: SLV (1W: +1.24% | 1M: -22.73%) RECOVERY for ongoing downside pressure in silver.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX watchpoint at ~20 — current VXX (1W: -0.61% | 1M: +7.46%) CORRECTION. HYG vs LQD spread watch — HYG (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +0.05%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +0.59%) CORRECTION showing neutral credit. XLK vs XLF crosswatch — XLK (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY vs XLF (1W: +0.31% | 1M: -4.58%) RECOVERY.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but risk ratios (VXX, SPY/TLT, HYG/LQD) are flat creating a mixed signal. Energy and cyclicals (XLE (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +7.86%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength while tech and China (XLK (1W: +0.74% | 1M: -4.99%) RECOVERY; FXI (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND) are key divergences to monitor.
